messages.message: Hello, John. I reviewed your latest health report. Your stress levels are a bit elevated but manageable.
Thank you doctor. What should I do today?
Practice deep breathing, light stretching, and try to keep tonight's sleep above 7 hours.

suggestions.title: Practice relaxation
suggestions.body: Practice deep breathing or short meditation for 10 minutes.

suggestions.title: Hydration reminder
suggestions.body: Drink water regularly and avoid staying dehydrated during the day.

suggestions.title: Light exercise
suggestions.body: Take a 15 minute walk or stretching break in the morning.
